content:
In the past few weeks I worked on a refactor that defines a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine as a special case of non-deterministic Turing machine, by adding the assumption that the transition relation of the machine is a function.
After some merged preparation PRs, this is the one that refactors the definition:
https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/964

The main benefit from this PR is that time and space definitions are shared by using the unified API of RunPath, which is based on a relation series in the transition relation of the machine.
It then gives us all the results about TM plumbing and bounding the number of configurations in terms of the used space were added recently, which is the following PR:
https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/22 (It's on my personal fork as I don't have permissions for creating a PR stack in the main fork. This is the PR on the main fork)

I'd love to get feedback regarding these PRs
